remarks: Easy on Easy of Exit 16/ I95! Enjoy convenient living in this updated ground-level unit! Approximately $90,000 in improvements provide excellent insulation and comfort throughout. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant countertop and prepping space, opening to a spacious neutrally decorated living room. The oversized primary bedroom features a large walk-in closet, and the second bedroom also includes its own walk-in closet. A full bath offers a shower stall and single vanity, with a stackable washer/dryer located discreetly between the kitchen and bathroom for added convenience.  Additional features include 2 assigned off-street parking spaces. Ideal location - close to Stew Leonard's, Calf Pasture Beach, and I-95 Exit 16 for easy commuting and everyday errands.  Please note: Both the Electricity and the Gas heat are commercially zoned. 680+ credit. One cat considered. Schedule your tour Today!
